review_status: Agent structural inferences; independent Korean review pending. Not a precision benchmark.
supported: Vowel-final omitted 이 directly before basic polite 오 + 리까; ordinary nominal/collapsed 거 and nominalizations use existing copula base recovery. Outer 마는/만 preserve their existing licenses.

primary_reviews.review: NIKL describes easily omitted copular 이 after vowels, with 그대로다 as its example. This is general omission evidence, not a direct license for every polite follower.
Basic polite vowel/consonant allomorphs and broad distribution are distinct from copula omission. Ri question is not divided into conjectural 리 + 까.

Read the publisher text. Direct 누구오리까 token in the Choi Min-sun translation confirms literary use beyond the pinned 1917 novel. Does not supply annotated morphological gold or contemporary ordinary-register acceptance.

pinned_annotated_corpora.method: For ordinary token rows in all six pinned UD files, use OrigLemma when present, otherwise LEMMA; align + morphemes with XPOS and select only exact audited forms tagged EP/ep.
pinned_annotated_corpora.caveat: Zero exact EP hits does not prove that the corpora have no polite usage. Broad surface scans include lexical 오다 and final 오; those are not new polite-prefinal gold cases.

gold_caveat: The six-file polite audit has zero exact polite EP hits; no new annotated omitted-polite question gold is claimed. Four complete output reports are preserved byte-for-byte.
remaining: Other basic polite allomorphs/followers, intervening prefinals, bundled honorific omission, 리까요 and contextual register need separate review. Generalization was retracted after individual-change review.
